title: War On The Rocks Archives
gist: This is a podcast-archive index page (a title list, not an article), showing War on the Rocks' recent flagship podcast episode lineup from December 2025 through August 2026 — its recurring subject matter clusters around Iran, Russia-Ukraine, China-Taiwan, and U.S. alliance/force-posture topics rather than any single analytical thesis.

insights.claim: War on the Rocks' flagship podcast episode list from December 2025 to August 2026 recurs heavily around three geopolitical flashpoints: the Iran war/uprising (multiple episodes including 'How We Arrived at this Iranian Moment,' 'The Reckoning of the Ayatollahs,' 'Inside Iran's Wartime Regime'), the Russo-Ukrainian war ('No End in Sight?', 'How Ukraine Put Russia on the Backfoot'), and U.S.-China/Taiwan tensions ('Is Time on China's Side?', 'Power, Paranoia, and the People's Liberation Army').
insights.speaker: War on the Rocks
insights.so_what: Confirms Iran, Ukraine/Russia, and China/Taiwan as War on the Rocks' three dominant recurring coverage clusters over an eight-month span, useful for gauging where this source's editorial and analytical attention (and by extension, expert-network access) concentrates.

insights.claim: The archive list includes an episode titled 'What Would Relations with Post-War Russia Look Like?' (May 28, 2026, featuring Rose Gottemoeller), indicating the publication was already exploring post-conflict Russia scenarios by that date.
insights.speaker: War on the Rocks
insights.so_what: A dated marker showing expert discussion of a post-war Russia relationship was already underway by late May 2026, useful context for tracking when 'post-war' framing entered mainstream defense-policy discourse.

insights.claim: An episode titled 'Reopening the Strait of Hormuz & Saving Downed Pilots' (April 6, 2026) predates the later 2026 Iran conflict escalation covered elsewhere in this source's output, indicating Hormuz access was already an active operational concern months before the peak of the sanctions/blockade standoff.
insights.speaker: War on the Rocks
insights.so_what: Establishes an early-April 2026 dateline for Hormuz reopening becoming an active U.S. military/policy topic, useful for constructing a timeline of the broader Iran conflict's escalation.
